name: Yahoo

profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is a Yahoo data center in the La Vista area of Sarpy County, Nebraska, part of the same Omaha area data center corridor that has also drawn facilities from Travelers Insurance, Google, and other large operators. Data Center Knowledge and Data Center Dynamics both covered the Nebraska facility opening and later expansion in trade press, and regional contractors including Cupertino Electric and a local roofing contractor have documented their own work on the project. Corporately, Yahoo has changed ownership more than once in recent years, having operated as Verizon Media following Verizon earlier acquisition of Yahoo core business, then sold to Apollo Global Management, with the transaction closing September 1, 2021 and Yahoo continuing afterward as a standalone company under Apollo Funds, with Verizon retaining a ten percent stake. No specific critical IT megawattage figure for this facility was found published from a tier one Yahoo owned source, though trade press describes it as a large scale internet services data center supporting Yahoo search, mail, and media products. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.

reading: Yahoo operates a data center in the La Vista area of Sarpy County, Nebraska, part of the same Omaha area data center corridor that has also drawn facilities from Travelers Insurance, Google, and other large operators, an area local economic impact research has valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars statewide. Data Center Knowledge and Data Center Dynamics both covered the Nebraska facility's opening and later expansion in trade press, and regional contractors including Cupertino Electric and a local roofing contractor have documented their own work on the project, corroborating the facility's existence and general history. Corporately, Yahoo has changed ownership more than once in recent years, having operated as Verizon Media following Verizon's earlier acquisition of Yahoo's core business, then sold to Apollo Global Management, with the transaction closing on September 1, 2021 and Yahoo continuing afterward as a standalone company under Apollo Funds, with Verizon retaining a ten percent stake according to Apollo's own announcement. No specific critical IT megawattage figure for the Sarpy County facility was found published from a tier one Yahoo owned source during this research, so that field is left unspecified rather than estimated, though the facility is understood in trade press to be a large scale, internet services data center supporting Yahoo's search, mail, and media products.
